_comment: ATTACK_POWER_GT_BASE is exactly 'power greater than its base power'. Was SELF_ATTACK_POWER_GTE with amount 'BASE_ATTACK_POWER'; that condition coerces a non-numeric amount to 0, so it read '>= 0' — ALWAYS TRUE, giving Thump dominate and the discard unconditionally.

abilities._comment: Was a plain STATIC, which nothing dispatches -- the ability never ran, while the card DB lists the keyword as printed, so the card had it unconditionally. WHILE_STATIC re-evaluates the gate on every attack-power recalculation, and the printed copy is suppressed for any keyword a card grants itself conditionally.
The '...and "If this hits a hero, they discard a card"' half was an INJECT_TRIGGER inside the dead STATIC, and its DISCARD named no player, so it would have discarded from the ATTACKER.
